name: Dimensions
description: Beyond the Overworld, this pack has a stack of places to travel.

pages.title: Dimensions
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Each has its own rules, materials and bosses. Next page: how to get in.
- Create Deep Seas' abyss is off in normal play.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Space: Northstar rockets, or an Aeronautics ship with a **Dimensional Drive**. Both need a Stellar Core.
Beyond the Overworld, this pack has a stack of places to travel. Each one has its own rules, materials and bosses. This page is the map of them and how to reach each.

- [#](2E5AAC)[The Nether](entry://exploration/nether)[#](): reworked by Incendium.
- [#](2E5AAC)[The End](entry://exploration/the_end)[#](): BetterEnd and YUNG's island.
- [#](2E5AAC)[The Aether](entry://exploration/aether)[#](): glowstone portal.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Twilight Forest](entry://exploration/twilight_forest)[#](): flower pool and a diamond.
- Create Deep Seas has an abyss dimension, but it is off in normal play: see [#](2E5AAC)[Submarines](entry://ocean/submarines)[#]().

**Space** is separate. Create: Northstar adds rockets and planets, see [#](2E5AAC)[Reaching Space](entry://space/reaching_space)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Planets](entry://space/planets)[#]().\
\
Aeronautics ships can launch there too, using a **Dimensional Drive** from the Northstar-Aeronautics bridge.\
\
Getting there is the pack's capstone: see [#](2E5AAC)[The Road to the Stars](entry://stars/why)[#]().

pages.title: Dimensional Drive
pages.text: Place on an Aeronautics ship, pick a Northstar planet, arm it, then fly to the trigger altitude.

The bridge lists the Moon, Mars, Venus, Mercury and Earth Orbit as drive destinations. Like every way into space, it needs a [#](2E5AAC)[Stellar Core](entry://stars/why)[#](). For airships see [#](2E5AAC)[Airships](entry://flight/airships)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Destinations](entry://flight/destinations)[#]().

Worldgen mods that change the Overworld itself (Terralith, Tectonic, Alex's Caves) are covered in [#](2E5AAC)[Worldgen](entry://exploration/worldgen)[#](). Structures to find on the way are in [#](2E5AAC)[Structures](entry://exploration/structures)[#]().
